item.title: How is public-private-civic collaboration transforming government?
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research exploring how collaboration between government, private sector, and civic organizations is reshaping the landscape of modern governance. We seek submissions that examine the mechanisms, challenges, and outcomes of public-private-civic partnerships in advancing government objectives and public service delivery.

Potential topics

  • Public-private-civic collaboration in government
  • Digital transformation in the public sector
  • Government technology and innovation
  • Collaborative governance models
  • Public sector modernization

Timeline

  • October 1, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
